stories.title: Rail bridge tops 'Britain's most bashed' list again
stories.summary: The A5 Watling Street railway bridge tops Network Rail's 2025-26 list with 26 strikes.

stories.title: Double-decker bus crashes into railway bridge
stories.summary: Trains were temporarily stopped after the bus struck the bridge in Kibworth.

stories.title: Rail operator adds two trains as new fleet delayed
stories.summary: The Class 221 trains are being introduced following delays to East Midlands Railway's new Aurora trains by Hitachi Rail.

stories.title: Patient says new kidney programme changed his life
stories.summary: The LUCID programme, which was pioneered in Leicestershire, aims to detect kidney disease early.

stories.title: Ancient forest recommended for Unesco global status
stories.summary: Charnwood Forest is put forward for the prestigious Unesco Global Geopark designation.

stories.title: Plans submitted for 130 homes in village
stories.summary: Hinckley and Bosworth Borough Council is expected to make a decision on the plans in the coming months.

stories.title: Council to consider borough-wide HMO rules
stories.summary: The authority previously introduced rules for areas of Hinckley, Barwell and Earl Shilton.

stories.title: Breeding success for swift nesting project
stories.summary: A project to boost swift numbers in Leicestershire has reported six breeding attempts in nest boxes.

stories.title: Tip reopens early as two more close for repairs
stories.summary: Repair works had been expected to last until mid-December.

stories.title: New £90k city centre planters dubbed 'ugly lumps'
stories.summary: A councillor has criticised the planters, but city mayor Sir Peter Soulsby called them "stylish".

stories.title: Plan for 'exciting' museum refurb set for approval
stories.summary: A council report says the proposed renovation would "secure the long-term future of the museum".

stories.title: Fresh attempt to kickstart stalled station revamp
stories.summary: The council says it is optimistic about securing a contractor after previous disappointment.
